newsitem.title: CONGO: New French troops arrive in Congo Brazzaville.
newsitem.headline: New French troops arrive in Congo Brazzaville.

text.p: A new contingent of 150 French troops joined around 300 others already in the Congo capital Brazzaville on Monday, where fighting rages between a political militia and loyalist soldiers, their commander said.
"A third of those we are expecting have arrived so far," Captain Alexis Jaraud, commanding troops already in Brazzaville, told Reuters.

Jaraud said around 400 French and other foreign nationals had been evacuated on board military transport planes to the Gabon capital Libreville, while an estimated 500 French citizens remain in Brazzaville for evacuation later.
Bloody street fighting has raged for five days in Brazzaville, between troops loyal to President Pascal Lissouba and a political militia loyal to ex-president Denis Sassou Nguesso.
